title: TikTok Creator Search Insights: A Practical Brand Guide
summary: Learn how TikTok Creator Search Insights surfaces search topics, content gaps, follower searches, and post analytics—and how brands can use those signals responsibly.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### What does Creator Search Insights show?


It shows personalized information about searched topics, including popular searches, content-gap topics and, for eligible accounts, searches by followers. It also provides search analytics for posts.


### How do I open Creator Search Insights?


In the TikTok app, search “creator search insights” and tap View when the official feature appears at the top of results.


### Why can I not see Searches by followers?


TikTok's help page says the filter can be used when an account has more than 1,000 followers. Region, rollout, account and app version can also affect the interface.


### Does Content gap guarantee views?


No. It is a topic-research signal. Performance still depends on relevance, creative execution, competition, audience, distribution and other factors.


### Is Creator Search Insights the same as Reacher creator discovery?


No. TikTok's tool researches content-search demand. Reacher supports finding and managing TikTok Shop creators and affiliate relationships.
